blocks.text: Comprehensive (mukammal) project planning ka matlab hai project shuru karne se pehle us ki tamam tafseelat par sochna. Is mein yeh samajhna shamil hai ke kya karna hai, kaun karega aur kaise kiya jayega.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Duniya ki kuch sab se bari software companies arbon dollar ki hain! Misal ke taur par 2023 tak Microsoft, jo software ki bari companies mein se hai, ki market capitalization (company ke tamam shares ki kul qeemat) 2 trillion dollar se zyada thi. Yeh bari qeemat dikhati hai ke aaj ke digital daur mein software development ka asar aur maashi (economic) ahmiyat kitni zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: Comprehensive project planning ka aham pehlu kya hai? (Exercise MCQ 7)
blocks.explanation: Project ka scope (daira) aur kaam samajhna, option (a): kya karna hai, kaun karega aur kaise. Kitab ki answer key (c) 'Hiring a large development team' deti hai, jo text se mel nahi khata.

items: Comprehensive planning: shuru se pehle tay karna ke kya karna hai, kaun karega aur kaise.
